title: Selling Plans Loyalty Relief on Early Termination Fees
content:
A **Selling Plans** store that has paid many subscription periods earns a loyalty relief on the early termination fee. Loyalty is counted from the plan's subscription fee records of the regular charge type, over the plan's whole life.

**Clause.** The loyalty relief of an early termination fee is the long loyalty relief when the plan has been billed at least the long loyalty count of regular subscription charges in all, the mid loyalty relief when it has been billed at least the mid loyalty count but fewer than the long loyalty count, and nothing otherwise.

A relief is taken from the plan's early termination fee share: the reliefs that apply are added together first and the total is taken from the share once.

## Schedule

| Regular subscription charges billed on the plan in all | Loyalty relief taken from the share |
|---|---|
| 36 or more (the long loyalty count) | 8 percentage points |
| 24 or more but fewer than 36 (the mid loyalty count up to the long) | 5 percentage points |
| Fewer than 24 | None |

Upgrade proration charges are not regular charges and are not counted; regular charges on the monthly and the annual term both count.

## Both sides of each count (hypothetical plans)

- 36 regular charges → 8 points; 35 → 5 points.
- 24 regular charges → 5 points; 23 → no loyalty relief.
